newsitem.title: PORTUGAL: Portuguese shares close at high for 1996.
newsitem.headline: Portuguese shares close at high for 1996.

text.p: 1715 GMT - Portuguese shares closed at a new high for the year and dealers said they could rise further tomorrow. Trade was concentrated in Portugal Telecom, Banco Comercial Portugues, Sonae Investimentos, Cimpor and Banco Portugues de Investimento.
* "Foreign markets are rising and as the dollar is firm, the market looks as though it will keep going higher," said one operator.
* Dealers said good results prospects for BCP and BPI pushed the stocks higher. PT adjusted higher in line with the price of PT shares in New York.
